title: sv-llm.entity-capability/v0.1
description: Entity-neutral capability declaration for Sandbox participation. Supports provider-class and non-provider SV-LLM entities. Registration additionally requires canonical organization-tree membership and an eligible class (INTELLIGENCE_PROVIDER, ECOSYSTEM_ENTITY). declaration_sha256 is the SV_LLM_CANONICAL_JSON_V1 digest of the parsed declaration. Declaring capabilities grants no governance authority.

role.description: Declared organizational or intelligence role; grants no governance authority.

interface_constraints.description: Machine-readable admission, invocation, evidence, privacy, cost, latency or other declared interface bounds.

prohibited.description: Authority and actions the entity does not possess.

path.description: Repository-relative path; never derived from provider or entity name.

capability_assignment_evidence.description: Evidence body of a CAPABILITY_ASSIGNMENT receipt. Step 1 carries the validated declaration inline. Runtime invariants: declaration_sha256 equals the SV_LLM_CANONICAL_JSON_V1 digest of declaration; capability is in declaration.capabilities; capability_declaration_ref.repository equals declaration.repository. Replacing inline carriage requires a versioned contract change.
